elements.name: wide night view of a busy avenue on the edge of Addis Ababa
pavements packed with people as dark shapes
tall concrete buildings with many lit windows
young man small in the lower part of the frame, seen from behind
standing at the roadside looking at the scene

notes: The young man fills most of the lower-centre height instead of being a small figure; shrink him to roughly a quarter of the frame height so the avenue dominates, and darken the twilight sky toward true night.
